primary_questions: Does the frozen winner-ranking signal reproduce outside DEV2000?
Does the simple price-independent 3renhuku structural challenger reproduce without using historical odds to select races?
Do Girls retain their much higher winner-ranking accuracy out of time?
Do score-gap effects on head-vs-companion predictability reproduce?

price_independent_ticket_challenger.frozen_model_lineage: exact DEV2000 candidate_a plus b1a_reconstituted_v1 ranking/confidence semantics; no model refit
rule: top PRE competition score minus second PRE score < 3.0
candidate_a and b1a_reconstituted_v1 agree on top1
one 3renhuku ticket = consensus conservative top3 set
no odds, payout or result is used to decide whether the race is selected
flat hypothetical stake 100 yen after selection freeze
price_independent_ticket_challenger.interpretation: Chosen as a simple price-independent falsification candidate, not because it won every subperiod. It deliberately carries known negative historical subblocks into the new test.

predeclared_metrics: selected ticket count and hit rate
hypothetical settlement ROI using outcome-side payout only after selection is frozen

pass_interpretation.rule: No single metric auto-promotes the candidate.
pass_interpretation.stronger_evidence: directionally positive ROI plus non-jackpot concentration plus preserved ranking signal across the new 500 is stronger than DEV2000-only search evidence.
pass_interpretation.failure: negative or concentrated outcome is retained as falsification; do not rescue-tune on the same 500.
